book_title: 小蓝本高中卷9 不等式的解题与技巧
stem_md: (反向柯西不等式——Polya-Szego 不等式) 设 $0 < m_{1} \leqslant a_{i} \leqslant M_{1}$, $0 < m_{2} \leqslant b_{i} \leqslant M_{2}$, $i = 1, 2, \cdots, n$, 则有: $$\frac{\left(\sum_{i=1}^{n} a_{i}^{2}\right)\left(\sum_{i=1}^{n} b_{i}^{2}\right)}{\left(\sum_{i=1}^{n} a_{i}b_{i}\right)^{2}} \leqslant \frac{1}{4} \cdot \left(\sqrt{\frac{M_{1}M_{2}}{m_{1}m_{2}}} + \sqrt{\frac{m_{1}m_{2}}{M_{1}M_{2}}}\right)^{2}.$$
